title: Consultant Services for Facilities Master Plan
short_description: Transit authority seeks consultants for a 10-year facilities master plan.
project_scope: Development of a comprehensive facilities master plan for SouthWest Transit to support projected growth in service area, fleet, staffing, and operations over a minimum 10-year planning horizon.
services: Facilities master planning, land use planning, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a facilities master planning assignment, not structural or bridge design.
- No building, bridge, roof, tower, or special structural scope is defined.
- The tender focuses on planning and land use rather than engineering of load-bearing structures.
- According to the exclusion notes, pure urban/open space planning and framework-type planning scopes are generally not relevant for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice describes only a master planning consultancy for future facility development over 10 years, without defined building areas, capacities, or construction quantities; therefore no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the source. As only a planning consultancy for a facilities master plan is tendered and no fee basis, scope breakdown, or budget is stated, no reliable estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms; disciplines requested include cost estimating, land use planning, and planning/master planning. No specific reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: SouthWest Transit Authority, Eden Prairie, MN, USA. Contact phone: 952-974-8326. Contact email: procurement@swtransit.org. Website: https://www.swtransit.org/about-swt/bids-proposals/
notes: Project number: 26-0003. Target market: Transportation. Pre-submittal meeting via Teams on 07/21/2026 at 02:00 PM CDT; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 07/29/2026 05:00 PM CDT. Solicitation documents available online. Although categorized here as Buildings for schema compliance, the notice is primarily a non-structural facilities master planning procurement.
